title: Dubai World Central – Al Maktoum (OMDW) for private jets
description: Al Maktoum International, Dubai World Central, for private flights: slots and permission, the runway, noise rules and how it compares with Dubai International.
h1: Dubai World Central – Al Maktoum International
lead: Dubai has two international airports. This guide covers Al Maktoum International at Dubai World Central, where several handling agents serve private aviation, from the official sources.

airport.name: Al Maktoum International Airport (Dubai World Central)

p: Every private flight here is planned in advance: {{omdw.slots}}. The operator arranges this through its handling agent. There is an extra lead time for the biggest aircraft: {{omdw.max_aircraft}}.
The airport is run by {{omdw.operator}}, which also runs Dubai International. Several handling agents serve private aviation at Dubai World Central; the operator of your flight appoints one.
Dubai World Central applies noise rules to every aircraft: {{omdw.noise}}. We confirm that the aircraft meets these rules before you receive a quote.
